verdict.rationale: Shortcut's own marketing documents custom fields for structuring a team's process, and it documents configurable per-workflow-state story limits. Neither source shows that a product manager can create, rename or reorder the workflow statuses themselves. Both claims are thin, single-line marketing statements. missing for 10: documented ability to create/edit/reorder custom workflow states, detail on custom field types and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Leverage custom fields to help you establish a more structured process for you and your teams.
Set story limits in each workflow state to stop work from piling up and keep everything moving smoothly.
